name: kyber_merge_cov
oracle_ref: 4 adjacent 4K reads [12288,12320) then 4 adjacent 4K writes [12544,12576) as contiguous same-op runs (plug merges are TAIL-ONLY in this kernel: blk-merge.c blk_attempt_plug_merge L1095-1099 — interleaved submission never merges), --merge-enable=1: plug merges collapse to 1-2 read requests + 1-2 write requests covering both ranges (total ISSUE nr == 64). Mirrors mqdd M05 merge-coverage semantics but split across two domains so G1 (max_inflight>=2) is achievable: read ISSUE and write ISSUE fire in the same dispatch run before either completes. NOTE: plug merges bypass the allow_merge/bio_merge hooks, so this case demonstrates merge BEHAVIOR; the --merge-enable flag itself is only observable via the kyber_merge_cfg map assertion in q_kyber_accept.sh.
notes: NEVER exact order (merge count/pattern nondeterministic: issue_count 2..7 acceptable, merge_count = trace_reqs - issues must be >=1). merge_coverage_min 64 = full 64-sector range covered by merged ISSUEs. Insert-count invariants intentionally absent (block_rq_insert dead under scx_io). Run as diagnostic-tier in q_kyber_accept.sh: strict G2 (>=2 OTHERS outstanding at an ISSUE) is structurally impossible when plug merging collapses 8 bios to <=2 issues, so this case gates on the literal G2 form (>=2 requests pending-not-completed at an ISSUE ts) and is not counted toward strict Tier-2 PASS.
